app.name: TravelWise
app.tagline: Plan Your Trip. Enjoy Every Moment.
app.bootErrorMessage: Your data is safe on this device. Please try again.

common.demoNotice: Sample data for demonstration only. It is not a real trip.

home.title: Your travels
home.emptyMessage: Create a trip to organise your itinerary, bookings, budget and packing — all offline, on your phone.
home.whyOffline: Works without Internet: everything is stored on your phone.
home.whyPrivate: No account. Your trips and documents never leave your device.
home.whyAllInOne: Itinerary, bookings, budget, packing and journal in one place.

tripCard.noPreparationData: Add packing items or tasks to track preparation

tripForm.name: Trip name
tripForm.destinationsHint: Add one city per stop. The first one is the main destination.
tripForm.timeZoneHint: Optional. Planned times are always local to the destination and are never shifted.
tripForm.travellersHint: Used later to split shared expenses.

errors.name_too_long: The name is too long (80 characters max).
errors.end_before_start: The return date must be on or after the departure date.
errors.invalid_country: Use a 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. PT, FR, JP).
errors.invalid_time_zone: Unknown time zone. Use a name like Europe/Lisbon.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Your data was not changed.
errors.currency_has_expenses: This trip already has expenses converted to its currency. Keep the currency, or delete the expenses first.

tripDetail.deleteMessage: This permanently deletes the trip and everything in it: itinerary, bookings, expenses, packing lists, journal, and the documents and photos stored for it. This cannot be undone.
tripDetail.sectionNext: This section is being built and will arrive in a next update.

budgetTab.title: Budgets
budgetTab.empty: Create a trip and set a budget to follow your spending here.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Plan your trips from A to Z: itinerary, bookings, budget, packing and travel documents. Everything stays on your phone and works offline.
onboarding.welcomeNote: TravelWise is an organiser, not a travel agency: it does not sell tickets or make reservations.
onboarding.currencyBody: Used by default for new trips. You can change it for each trip.
onboarding.firstTripBody: You can create a trip now or explore the app first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacySummary: Your trips, documents and photos are stored only on this device. TravelWise has no account and no server. Nothing is synchronised to a cloud.
settings.analyticsHint: Only anonymous events (e.g. "trip created"), never names, places, amounts or documents. Off by default.
settings.deleteAllMessage: This permanently deletes every trip, document, photo and setting stored by TravelWise on this device. This cannot be undone.
settings.documentsLockHint: Ask for your fingerprint, face or phone screen lock before showing documents. It hides them in the app; it does not encrypt them.
settings.documentsLockUnavailable: Set up a screen lock or biometrics on your phone first.

itinerary.emptyMessage: Create one day per trip date, or start from an editable template.
itinerary.needDates: Set the trip dates to build a day-by-day itinerary.
itinerary.missingDays: Some trip dates have no day yet.
itinerary.timesNote: Times are local to each destination and never change when your phone changes time zone.
itinerary.deleteDayMessage_one: Its {{count}} activity will be deleted too.
itinerary.deleteDayMessage_other: Its {{count}} activities will be deleted too.

errors.invalid_duration: Enter a duration in minutes (0 to 1440).
errors.date_taken: This date already has a day.

activity.name: Name
activity.timeHint: Optional. Leave empty for an activity without a fixed time.

templates.title: Itinerary templates
templates.disclaimer: Templates are editable outlines with neutral time slots. They contain no real places or schedules: adapt everything to your trip.

bookings.disclaimer: TravelWise does not connect to airlines, hotels or any provider. Everything here is entered by you and is not verified: always check with the provider.
bookings.emptyMessage: Keep your flights, hotels, trains and tickets in one place, available offline.
bookings.deleteMessage: Only the information saved in TravelWise is deleted. Your actual booking is not affected.

errors.provider_or_reference_required: Enter at least a provider, a reference or a route.
errors.end_before_start: The end date must be on or after the start date.

booking.providerPlaceholder: e.g. airline, hotel or company name
booking.referenceHint: Copy it exactly from your confirmation.
booking.localTimeHint: Enter the local times shown on your ticket or confirmation.
booking.noPayment: Never enter card numbers or other payment details here.

packing.title: Packing lists
packing.emptyMessage: Start from a template and adapt it, or build your own list.

budget.noPlan: No budget planned yet. Set one to follow what is left.
budget.planHint: Amounts in {{currency}}, the trip currency. All fields are optional.

insights.title: Insights
insights.empty: Insights appear once you record expenses. Nothing is estimated.
insights.allowance: To stay on budget: about {{amount}} per remaining day

shared.title: Shared expenses
shared.empty: Split an expense between travellers to see who owes whom.
shared.noPayment: TravelWise only calculates balances. It never makes or requests any payment.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.emptyMessage: Record what you spend to follow your budget, even offline.
expenses.usingSavedRate: Using your saved rate from {{date}}. Type a rate to use another one.
expenses.noSavedRate: No saved rate for this currency: type the rate you got.
expenses.rememberRate: Save this rate for the trip
expenses.paymentHint: A label only (e.g. "Card"). Never enter a card number.

errors.invalid_rate: Enter the exchange rate (a positive number).
errors.payer_required: Choose who paid to share this expense.
errors.unknown_participant: This traveller is no longer part of the trip.
errors.looks_like_card_number: This looks like a card number. Never store payment details here.
errors.shares_mismatch: The shares must add up exactly to the amount.

converter.title: Currency converter
converter.manualNotice: Offline mode: enter the exchange rate you got (bank, exchange office, card app). TravelWise does not show live rates.
converter.noRate: No rate saved for {{from}} → {{to}}. Enter one above.
converter.bankWarning: Indicative only: the rate actually applied by your bank or card may differ, and fees may apply.

errors.no_rate: Enter or save an exchange rate first.

documents.title: Documents
documents.privacyNote: Documents are copied into TravelWise’s private storage on this phone and work offline. They are never uploaded. They are protected by your phone’s security, not encrypted by TravelWise.
documents.emptyMessage: Add tickets, booking confirmations or insurance documents (PDF or image) to keep them offline.
documents.pickHint: Choose a PDF or an image from your phone (up to {{max}}). A private copy is kept by TravelWise; the original stays where it is.
documents.passportHint: Tip: you can store only the passport number and expiry date in the notes instead of a scan.
documents.noViewer: No app on this phone can open this file.
documents.fileMissing: The file of this document is missing on this phone. You can delete this entry and add the document again.
documents.deleteMessage: The document and its private copy will be permanently deleted from this phone. The original file you picked is not affected.
documents.lockedMessage: Unlock with your fingerprint, face or phone screen lock.

errors.unsupported_file: Only PDF and image files (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) can be added.
errors.insufficient_storage: Not enough free storage on this phone to keep a copy of this file.
errors.copy_failed: The file could not be copied. Nothing was saved.
errors.source_missing: The selected file is no longer available.

tasks.officialDisclaimer: Visa, passport and entry requirements change. TravelWise does not provide official or up-to-date information: always check with the official authorities of your destination.
tasks.title: Task
tasks.reminderHint: A local notification on this phone at the chosen date and time.
tasks.reminderPast: Choose a reminder time in the future.
tasks.permissionDenied: Notifications are turned off for TravelWise. The task is saved, but no reminder will appear until you allow notifications in Android settings.

weather.title: Weather notes
weather.cardHint: Note the weather you expect to adapt your packing list. No forecast is shown.
weather.disclaimer: TravelWise shows no forecast. Note here the conditions you expect (from a source you trust) to get packing suggestions.

places.mapNotice: Places open in a map app installed on your phone (e.g. Google Maps). TravelWise has no built-in map and does not calculate routes.
places.noMapApp: No map app could open this place.
places.emptyMessage: Save restaurants, hotels, sights or addresses you want to remember.
places.name: Name
places.coordinatesHint: Paste latitude, longitude from a map app if you have them. Never required.

journal.privacy: Your journal and photos stay on this phone. Nothing is sent to a server.
journal.emptyMessage: Write a few lines and add photos each day to keep your memories.
journal.title: Title
journal.textPlaceholder: What did you see, eat, feel today?
journal.photoDenied: TravelWise could not open your photos. Check the permission in Android settings.
journal.deleteMessage: The entry and its photo copies will be permanently deleted from TravelWise. Photos in your gallery are not affected.

errors.empty_entry: Write something or add a photo.
errors.too_many_photos: Too many photos for one entry.
